title: Attachment Style Exploration
name: Attachment Style Exploration
description: Understand your patterns in close relationships

subscales.name: Anxiety
subscales.description: Worry about abandonment and need for reassurance in relationships

subscales.name: Avoidance
subscales.description: Discomfort with closeness and reluctance to depend on others

resultTypes.name: Secure
resultTypes.description: You tend to feel comfortable with closeness and are confident in your relationships. You find it relatively easy to depend on others and have others depend on you.

resultTypes.name: Anxious-Preoccupied
resultTypes.description: You tend to seek high levels of closeness and approval from others. You may worry about whether your relationships are as strong as you want them to be.

resultTypes.name: Dismissive-Avoidant
resultTypes.description: You tend to value independence and self-sufficiency. You may prefer not to depend on others or have others depend on you.

resultTypes.name: Fearful-Avoidant
resultTypes.description: You may have mixed feelings about closeness. You desire close relationships but may find it difficult to trust or depend on others fully.
